newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB's Yorkshire Bank sells two units.
newsitem.headline: NAB's Yorkshire Bank sells two units.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Monday that its Yorkshire Bank Plc unit would sell two point-of-sale credit subsidiaries to National Westminster Bank Plc unit Lombard Tricity Finance Ltd.
NAB did not reveal the price to be paid by Lombard for Yorkshire Bank Retail Services Ltd and Storecard Ltd.

It said negotiations were continuing, with final agreement due by the end of next month. The subsidiaries offer finance through selected retialers to customers at the point of sale and had combined net assets of 15 million pounds stg.
